verdicts.quote: Propose a Lightning web component exposed as a custom tab and available from App Launcher → All Items. ... The app does not attach Salesforce identity or record data
Preserve Salesforce business data and existing automation by making no business record reads or writes. ... An earlier prompt, reply or Salesforce record is never included.
making no business record reads or writes ... The app does not attach Salesforce identity or record data
Assign tab, runtime class and provider principal access only to designated users, with a specific runtime bot entitlement ... The Salesforce administrator controls grants and configuration.
The viewer sees only their own current prompt and reply. ... Another user or view has no access to that exchange through the app. ... There are no conversation records
Propose one imperative, noncached call from the Lightning component to Apex, with a bounded Salesforce callout ... One bounded foreground request per admitted send.
verdicts.missing: The callout-after-DML and trigger restrictions are not stated, and the design is synchronous rather than asynchronous (Queueable/future/batch); a builder must decide how to respect those transaction rules.

verdicts.quote: Use the extensible Named Credential and Custom Authentication External Credential with a dedicated named principal. ... No credential material appears in app/UI payloads, logs or deployment files.
Salesforce documents 120 seconds cumulative callout time per Apex transaction and 6 MB for synchronous callout request or response, also subject to heap.
verdicts.missing: Callouts-per-transaction count, a heap figure and the CPU time limit are not given with numbers.

verdicts.quote: Hold a controlled provider response, attempt a second send ... Inject 401, 403, 404, 429, 503, transport timeout, incomplete, malformed ... outcomes independently.
verdicts.missing: It does not say Apex tests cannot make real callouts or require an HttpCalloutMock-style mock implementation.

verdicts.quote: Use the extensible Named Credential ... The fixed provider base is `https://api.x.ai`; the operation is `POST /v1/responses` over HTTPS
Propose one imperative, noncached call from the Lightning component to Apex ... No subscription or durable bot event stream is in scope.
verdicts.missing: The interface relies on the inline return of a synchronous call; no asynchronous arrival mechanism (platform event, polled status, LMS) is defined despite the acknowledged timeout conflict.

verdicts.quote: Repeated sends while pending cause no duplicate call from that view. ... Any later result for the failed attempt is ignored. ... there is no automatic retry or resumable job.
Salesforce documents a 20 concurrent off-domain callout cap specifically for Developer Edition, which must first be established for the target.
verdicts.missing: What the user sees or what happens to a request rejected because the concurrency cap is reached.
